questions.stem: Why do plants convert glucose into starch for storage?

options.text: Starch is easier to transport around the plant
Starch is insoluble and will not affect the water potential of cells
Starch contains more energy per gram than glucose
Starch can be used directly in respiration

questions.explanation: Starch is insoluble, so it does not affect the water potential of cells by osmosis. This makes it ideal for storage as a compact, insoluble molecule.
